THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
194
STUDY 162
Brown Long-Sleeve Top & Cargo Parachute Pants
Rights check
Source: 25062.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, curly honey-blonde
hair walks through a bright indoor corridor carrying a
large black leather duffel bag. She wears a fitted black
long-sleeve scoop-neck top that stops above the waist,
layered with two thin silver necklaces. Taupe ruched
parachute cargo trousers with drawstrings and a low
waistband complete the look. Her expression is calm
and serious. Soft, cool interior light with a blurred figure
behind her. Palette of chocolate, taupe, and black.
Nostalgic and utilitarian, in the style of a late-1990s film
still.
Nostalgic, utilitarian, candid
WORKING NOTES
- The curly hair and parachute trousers are the signature
elements.
- Keep the blurred background for a candid, on-the-move
feel.
